description: This file defines the application's theme configuration, including color schemes, app bar styles, floating action button styles, input decorations, and list tile themes for a Flutter application.

classes.name: AppColors
classes.description: Defines static constants for primary, secondary, and accent colors used throughout the app.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: Provides theme data configurations for light and dark themes based on color schemes.

methods.name: _base
methods.description: Generates a ThemeData object configured with a color scheme, app bar, floating action button, input decoration, and list tile themes based on the seed color and brightness.
parameters: seed: Color for primary color generation

methods.name: lightTheme
methods.description: Provides the ThemeData configured for light mode.

methods.name: darkTheme
methods.description: Provides the ThemeData configured for dark mode.
